judges.name: PLAN fidelity
judges.description: Verifies the iteration's deliverables match what PLAN.md (and the current phase doc) actually asks for. Flags scope drift early.
judges.prompt: You are scoring an iteration against the Mockingbird PLAN. Read PLAN.md (spine) and docs/phases/phase{N}.md, then read STATUS.md and the last commit's diff. Score 0-10 on PLAN fidelity. Explicitly cite any deliverable the iteration claimed-done that the PLAN does NOT actually mandate, and any PLAN mandate the iteration silently skipped. Reply in JSON: {score, summary, drift_in[], drift_out[], next_action}.

judges.name: Invariant guard
judges.description: Checks the eight binding invariants from AGENTS.md are respected by the iteration's diff.
judges.prompt: Examine the iteration's diff (git diff against the previous tag or commit). For each of these invariants, report PASS / FAIL / N/A with a one-line justification: (1) raw transcripts immutable; (2) provenance total; (3) layers replaceable; (4) no telemetry; (5) cross-platform abstractions; (6) clipboard save/restore around paste; (7) secure-input fields abort injection; (8) no @tanstack/* dependency. Reply in JSON: {invariants:{name, status, note}, overall}.

judges.name: Quality bar
judges.description: Verifies fmt/clippy/tests are green AND the iteration didn't disable any lint/test to make them green.
judges.prompt: Read the diff. Confirm: (a) cargo fmt clean (no .rustfmt.toml relaxation), (b) clippy clean WITHOUT any new #[allow] without a justifying comment, (c) tests pass AND none were marked #[ignore] or deleted, (d) test count went up or stayed equal to LOC growth ratio. Reply in JSON: {fmt, clippy, tests, suppressed_lints[], deleted_tests[], verdict}.

judges.name: STATUS.md hygiene
judges.description: Confirms STATUS.md was updated and contains the required sections (task progress, cost line, blocked-on, last-judge).
judges.prompt: Open STATUS.md. Confirm it includes: current phase, last-updated date, completed tasks for this iteration, an updated cost line, a Blocked-on section, and a Last-successful-judge-run line. Reply in JSON: {present:{phase, updated, completed, cost, blocked, last_judge}, missing_sections[]}.

judges.name: STT correctness (Phase 2)
judges.description: Verifies the Whisper STT pipeline produces a non-fabricated transcript that matches expected output within edit-distance tolerance on a known speech fixture. Hard-blocks the phase-2-complete tag.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-2/stt-correct.md and follow its pass criteria. Run `cargo test --workspace -- whisper::` and check the three integration tests pass. If a real-speech fixture exists at tests/fixtures/audio/hello.wav with a .expected.txt sidecar, run `target\release\stt_test.exe tests/fixtures/audio/hello.wav --json`, parse the JSON, lowercase + whitespace-normalise the .text field, and compute Levenshtein edit distance against the sidecar. Pass if distance <= 25% of expected length AND model_id == 'whisper-large-v3-turbo-q5_0' AND latency_ms > 0. Reply in JSON: {tests_pass, fixture_match, edit_distance, expected_length, model_id_ok, latency_ok, verdict, notes}.

judges.name: CUDA verified (Phase 2)
judges.description: Verifies that Whisper actually uses GPU (cuBLAS / CUDA) on this device — not silently falling back to CPU. Hard-blocks the phase-2-complete tag per PLAN line 1362.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-2/cuda-verified.md. Verify ALL of: (1) Cargo.toml has whisper-rs with features=["cuda"] active (not commented out); (2) `cargo build --release --bin stt_test` succeeds with cuda backend; (3) Running the binary on a speech WAV emits a stderr line matching /CUDA|cuBLAS|gpu_device|cudart/ AND does NOT emit 'use gpu = 0' or 'no GPU found'; (4) The --json output has gpu_used:true. Each criterion is binary pass/fail. Reply in JSON: {cargo_feature_on, build_ok, runtime_cuda_lines:[...], gpu_used_json, verdict, blocker_reason}.

judges.name: STT performance budget (Phase 2)
judges.description: Verifies end-to-end transcribe latency < 1000 ms for 10s of speech audio on GPU. PLAN line 1376 budget. Gated behind cuda-verified — CPU runs are informational only.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-2/perf-stt.md. If the cuda-verified judge passed in this iteration, run `cargo bench --bench whisper_latency` and parse the criterion JSON output at target/criterion/whisper_latency_*/new/estimates.json. Pass if mean point_estimate (in ns, divide by 1_000_000 for ms) is < 1000 AND p95 < 1500 on a 10-second speech fixture. If only the synthetic sine fixture exists, report 'fixture-missing' and mark NOT_RUN (not FAIL). If cuda-verified did NOT pass, mark NOT_RUN and explain the gating. Reply in JSON: {cuda_gate_ok, mean_ms, p95_ms, fixture_used, verdict}.

judges.name: Supply-chain hygiene
judges.description: If package.json, package-lock.json, Cargo.toml, or Cargo.lock changed, audits the new deps against the IOC list and the project's banned-namespace rules.
judges.prompt: Examine the diff for changes to package.json, package-lock.json, Cargo.toml, or Cargo.lock. For each added/upgraded dep, check: (a) not in @tanstack/* namespace, (b) not in the PLAN Appendix D IOC list, (c) lockfile updated alongside, (d) no install scripts enabled. Reply in JSON: {npm_changes[], cargo_changes[], violations[], verdict}.

judges.name: End-to-end injection (Phase 3)
judges.description: Verifies the full DictationOrchestrator::run loop drives a StartCapture→StopCapture cycle through to a real Injector::inject call AND a session row with injection_status='ok'. Hard-blocks the phase-3-complete tag.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-3/e2e-injection.md and follow its three pass criteria. Run (in this order, with $env:ORT_DYLIB_PATH = "$env:USERPROFILE\mockingbird_models\onnxruntime.dll" exported first): (1) `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --workspace --lib -- dictation::tests::happy_path_proceeds_with_paste --exact`; (2) `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --test dictation_orchestrator -- happy_path_injects_calls_writes_three_transcripts_and_ok_status --exact`; (3) `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --test dictation_orchestrator -- cleaned_text_round_trips_through_injector_call_verbatim --exact`. Each must report `test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed`. Reply in JSON: {pure_decision, e2e_happy_path, text_fidelity, verdict, blocker_reason}.

judges.name: DB provenance is total (Phase 3)
judges.description: Verifies every session row's provenance columns are non-NULL and that transcripts land at the expected stages (3 on Ok, 2 on AbortedSecure). Hard-blocks the phase-3-complete tag.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-3/db-provenance.md. With $env:ORT_DYLIB_PATH set, run: (1) `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --test dictation_orchestrator -- happy_path_injects_calls_writes_three_transcripts_and_ok_status --exact`; (2) `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --test dictation_orchestrator -- secure_input_aborts_injector_unused_two_transcripts_aborted_status --exact`. Both must pass. Additionally, examine the test source at src-tauri/tests/dictation_orchestrator.rs and confirm the assertions still check: prompt_id/dictionary_snapshot_id/example_set_id are .is_some(), foreground_app == 'notepad.exe', transcripts count == 3 on happy path and == 2 on abort path, and the abort path explicitly does NOT contain stage 'final'. Reply in JSON: {happy_path_test, abort_path_test, assertions_still_present, verdict, blocker_reason}.

judges.name: Clipboard restored (Phase 3)
judges.description: Verifies the four-step clipboard dance restores the user's original clipboard contents after injection. CI portion is pure analysis; the live round-trip is #[ignore]d and must be run manually before tagging. Hard-blocks the phase-3-complete tag.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-3/clipboard-restored.md. With $env:ORT_DYLIB_PATH set, run: (1) `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --workspace --lib -- injection::paste::tests`. All pure tests must pass with zero failures. (2) Confirm `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --workspace --lib -- injection::paste::tests::live_snapshot_then_write_then_restore_preserves_text --ignored --exact` is present in the test binary (will require manual run with a live clipboard available). (3) Examine the diff for any newly added `#[allow(...)]` attributes in `src-tauri/src/injection/paste.rs` — flag any that lack a justifying comment. Reply in JSON: {pure_tests_pass, live_test_present, new_allows[], verdict, blocker_reason}.

judges.name: Secure input respected (Phase 3)
judges.description: Verifies that when SecureInputGuard returns true, the injector is NOT called, no `final` transcript row is written, and the session row records injection_status='aborted_secure'. Most safety-critical judge in Phase 3. Hard-blocks the phase-3-complete tag.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-3/secure-input-respected.md. With $env:ORT_DYLIB_PATH set, run all four targets: (1) `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --workspace --lib -- dictation::tests::secure_input_aborts_even_if_focus_matches --exact`; (2) `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --workspace --lib -- dictation::tests::focus_change_into_secure_input_still_aborts --exact`; (3) `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --test dictation_orchestrator -- secure_input_aborts_injector_unused_two_transcripts_aborted_status --exact`; (4) `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --workspace --lib -- db::sessions::tests::injection_status_persists_aborted_secure --exact`. Each must report `test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed`. Reply in JSON: {pure_decision, belt_and_suspenders, e2e_orchestrator, db_round_trip, verdict, blocker_reason}.
